summary: Iteration 4 tested the MT5 rate feed (simulated fallback), per-jeweller margins, custom domains and tenant resolve on the backend, the master and jeweller admin panels, and the Expo app. BACKEND: 14/14 new pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_margins_domains_feed.py. /api/price returns source=simulated, live=false, base_rate and silver.base_rate, with buy=base*(1+markup) and sell=base*(1-discount). PUT /jeweller/settings/margins rejects values outside 0-50 with 422, requires a jeweller token and returns a price that uses the new margins. /api/price and /api/quote for that jeweller's customer (gold and silver) use the new margins, and /orders/buy locks in the margin-applied rate. The other jeweller's prices do not change. /master/rate.feed = {source:simulated, configured:false, error:'MT5_RATES_URL not configured'}. Domains: scheme, path and port are stripped and the domain is lowercased. Invalid domains return 400, the same app and admin domain returns 400, and a domain used by another jeweller returns 409. tenant/resolve returns kind app or admin (port and case are ignored) and 404 for unknown or empty hosts. domain-check returns cname_target and domains. All domains were cleared and margins reset to 0/3/0/3 (verified). MASTER PANEL: #feed-status shows '● Indicative rate — MT5 feed not connected' plus 'MT5_RATES_URL not configured'. The Jewellers table has a DOMAINS column. The Domains modal (#d_app, #d_admin, #save-domains) saves the normalized domain, shows the CNAME instructions and a DNS status table ('DNS pending'), and pops alerts for invalid or duplicate domains. JEWELLER PANEL: Price Margins card (#m_gb/#m_gs/#m_sb/#m_ss, #save-margins) saves and shows a confirmation alert with the new buy/sell rates. The dashboard 'Your Gold Rate' card shows 'Indicative · base ₹x/g'. EXPO APP (390x844): prices load, and a 2% margin set via the API showed up on the home gold card within one 5s refresh (ratio 1.02). OTP login (Meera 9834567892) and buying ₹50 of gold work: balance went from 1.3338g to 1.3406g with the message '✅ Bought 0.0068g gold for ₹51.50'. All tabs navigate. FAILED: the home screen does NOT show the 'Indicative Rate' label, and testID gold-rate-source is not present. app/(tabs)/index.tsx renders its own inline price cards, and the PriceCards component is not imported anywhere.

minor.issue: Onboarding normalizes body.domain but never checks it against other jewellers' domain/admin_domain, so two jewellers can end up with the same domain. PUT /domains does return 409 for this. Reference: server.py:1541

The quote is not tied to the caller: there is no check that q.jeweller_id == customer.jeweller_id, and the quote is not marked as used. A customer of jeweller B could pay with a quote from jeweller A at A's lower margin, and one quote can be reused for its whole lock window. Reference: server.py:774-781

A suspended jeweller's domain returns 404, so the app silently falls back to DEFAULT_JEWELLER_ID (Sharma). That jeweller's custom domain would then show another tenant's branding and prices. It should show a 'store unavailable' screen instead. Reference: server.py:1682, AppContext.tsx:111

ui_bugs.issue: No 'Indicative Rate' or 'Live Rate' label, and testID gold-rate-source is missing. app/(tabs)/index.tsx:95-128 renders its own inline cards, and src/components/PriceCards.tsx (which has the label) is never imported. LiveTicker in src/components/Header.tsx ('INDICATIVE') and src/components/BuyWidget.tsx are also unused. Customers are not told that the rate is indicative.

The arrow and color come from price.direction (the last 3s tick), but the number comes from price.change (vs open). The result is wrong text: '+-8.13 (-0.11%)' with a green up icon, '19.32 (0.27%)' in red with a down icon, and '0.05 (0.05%)' with no sign. Base the direction on the sign of change. Reference: app/(tabs)/index.tsx:56-57,109,124
A value above 50 (e.g. 60) shows the alert '[object Object]'. FastAPI returns the 422 detail as an array, and apiFetch does new Error(d.detail). Reference: jeweller_admin.html:77
An empty input is silently saved as 0 (parseFloat(v||'0')). Clearing the gold markup field and saving wiped the markup without any warning. Reference: jeweller_admin.html:146

issues: The Price Margins copy says 'Applied on top of the live MT5 base rate' even while the feed is simulated or indicative.
The preview shows ≈0.0069g but 0.0068g is credited. The UI rounds with toFixed(4) while the backend floors with r4. Minor, but customers may notice.
Silver is labelled '24K | 999'. Karat applies only to gold, so this should be '999 Fine'.

action_items: HIGH: Show the rate source on home: render the 'Indicative Rate' / 'Live Rate' label with testID gold-rate-source (using price.live) in app/(tabs)/index.tsx, or replace the inline cards with <PriceCards/>. Remove the dead components (PriceCards, LiveTicker, src/components/BuyWidget.tsx) or wire them in.
Fix the home change sign and direction: use change >= 0 for the arrow and color, and format as `${change>=0?'+':''}${change.toFixed(2)}`.
Admin panels apiFetch: when detail is an array, join detail.map(e=>e.msg) so 422 errors are readable. Validate empty margin inputs on the client instead of defaulting to 0.
POST /master/jewellers: run the same domain/admin_domain conflict check (409) as PUT /domains.
/orders/buy: reject quotes where q.jeweller_id != customer.jeweller_id, and consider marking quotes as used.
Custom domain of a suspended or unknown tenant: show a 'store unavailable' screen instead of falling back to the default jeweller.
Change the margin card copy to 'base rate (live MT5 or indicative)'.

The old test files /app/backend/tests/test_vaultra_api.py, test_gifts_alerts.py, test_goals.py and /app/backend_test_comprehensive.py target the v1 API (/tenants, staff PIN admin, etc.). They now fail with 20 errors and 7 failures against v2.0. Rewrite or delete them; they are not a regression from this change.
server.py is 1930 lines. Split it into routers (routes/ dir exists).
critical_code_review_comments: price_payload and margin math are correct. MARGINS is an in-process cache refreshed on update and startup, so it works only with a single worker. With multiple uvicorn workers, other workers would serve stale margins.
The backend auto-reloads when files under /app/backend/tests change (uvicorn --reload watches the whole dir), so creating test files restarted the backend mid-run.
The OTP rate limit (5/min/phone) makes back-to-back regression runs return 429. Tests should use unique phones.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (admin panels 100%; Expo app: prices, margin propagation, login and buy pass; Indicative label missing)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. One ₹50 gold buy was made for Meera (9834567892): 1.3338g -> 1.3406g. A 'Test Jewellers 37514' jeweller already existed from an earlier run. All domains are empty and all margins are reset to 0/3/0/3.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with '-n 0' (pytest.ini enables xdist), otherwise the margin tests race with the default-price test. The Expo web stack keeps hidden copies of earlier screens, so use ' >> visible=true' locators. The home screen has almost no testIDs (login, buy widget, price cards); selectors used: input[placeholder='Phone number'], text 'Get OTP', 'Verify & Login' (OTP auto-filled), input[placeholder='Enter amount'], text 'Buy'. Admin panels: master #lu/#lp prefilled, Login button; jeweller #le/#lp prefilled.
